answer: Bond decay works like a rental deposit that shrinks while idle. An identity buys a 120-unit bond locked 10 epochs; it earns nothing and loses 4% of face value each epoch, so a parked bond falls under 60 units by epoch 10 and the identity hits its nadir — downgraded and stripped of rewards. Only verified work refreshes it to full value. A forger with 1,000 bonds loses 4,800 units per epoch, and the summit of loss is 40,000 units after 10 idle epochs. Cheating forfeits 50% of the remainder and freezes refresh 6 epochs. The oasis of free identities dries up.
